observations.name: disjunction-instead-of-IN
observations.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t0.entity_id) AS "?count",
  NULL AS "?value",
  CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN 0 WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "_triplex_value_0_category",
  COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime) AS "_triplex_value_0_order_number",
  COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json) AS "_triplex_value_0_order_text",
  CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN 'number' WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 'boolean' WHEN (t0.value_type = 'string' OR t0.value_type = 'ref' OR t0.value_type = 'blob' OR t0.value_type = 'json') THEN 'string' ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_type",
  CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'string' OR t0.value_type = 'ref' OR t0.value_type = 'blob' OR t0.value_type = 'json') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json) ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_string",
  CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime) ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_number",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN t0.value_boolean ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_boolean"
FROM (SELECT * FROM tx_assertions FOR ALL VALID_TIME WHERE scope_key = $1) t0
WHERE t0.retracted_at IS NULL AND t0.attribute = $2
GROUP BY CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN 0 WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime), COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json), CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN 'number' WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 'boolean' WHEN (t0.value_type = 'string' OR t0.value_type = 'ref' OR t0.value_type = 'blob' OR t0.value_type = 'json') THEN 'string' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'string' OR t0.value_type = 'ref' OR t0.value_type = 'blob' OR t0.value_type = 'json') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN (t0.value_type = 'number' OR t0.value_type = 'datetime') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN t0.value_boolean ELSE NULL END

observations.name: group-projection-aliases
observations.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t0.entity_id) AS "?count",
  NULL AS "?value",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type IN ('number', 'datetime') THEN 0 WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "_triplex_value_0_category",
  COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime) AS "_triplex_value_0_order_number",
  COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json) AS "_triplex_value_0_order_text",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type IN ('number', 'datetime') THEN 'number' WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN 'boolean' WHEN t0.value_type IN ('string', 'ref', 'blob', 'json') THEN 'string' ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_type",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type IN ('string', 'ref', 'blob', 'json') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_string, t0.value_json) ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_string",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type IN ('number', 'datetime') THEN COALESCE(t0.value_number, t0.value_datetime) ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_number",
  CASE WHEN t0.value_type = 'boolean' THEN t0.value_boolean ELSE NULL END AS "_triplex_value_0_boolean"
FROM (SELECT * FROM tx_assertions FOR ALL VALID_TIME WHERE scope_key = $1) t0
WHERE t0.retracted_at IS NULL AND t0.attribute = $2
GROUP BY "_triplex_value_0_category", "_triplex_value_0_order_number", "_triplex_value_0_order_text", "_triplex_value_0_type", "_triplex_value_0_string", "_triplex_value_0_number", "_triplex_value_0_boolean"
